name: Cornea Confidential
description: Cornea, conjunctiva, tear film, and anterior chamber — infectious keratitis, dystrophies, ectasias, cross-linking, endothelial disorders, and anterior chamber grading.

episodes.title: Corneal Anatomy: The Five Layers and Why Each Matters
episodes.description: From epithelium to endothelium — how each layer contributes to clarity and where disease strikes.

episodes.title: Epithelium: The First Barrier and Its Common Failures
episodes.description: Abrasions, erosions, and the recurrent erosion syndrome that follows seemingly minor trauma.

episodes.title: Bowman’s Layer: Where Scars Begin
episodes.description: Why superficial keratectomy matters and how trauma here leaves permanent opacities.

episodes.title: Stroma: Collagen Architecture and Edema Mechanics
episodes.description: How stromal lamellae maintain transparency and the osmotic forces that cause corneal swelling.

episodes.title: Descemet’s Membrane and Endothelium: The Pump That Keeps the Cornea Clear
episodes.description: Endothelial pump function, guttae, and why counting cells changes the management plan.

episodes.title: Bacterial Keratitis: The Ulcer at the Slit Lamp
episodes.description: Differentiating bacterial from fungal and Acanthamoeba — the morphological clues that guide empiric therapy.

episodes.title: Fungal Keratitis: Feathery Edges and Satellite Lesions
episodes.description: Recognizing fungal morphology, the risk factors of trauma and contact lens wear, and the referral threshold.

episodes.title: Acanthamoeba Keratitis: The Ring and the Agony
episodes.description: The ring infiltrate, disproportionate pain, and why early diagnosis is the only chance to save the eye.

episodes.title: Herpes Simplex Keratitis: Dendrites, Disciform, and the Steroid Trap
episodes.description: Epithelial versus stromal HSV — the fluorescein staining pattern and the topical steroid decision.

episodes.title: Herpes Zoster Ophthalmicus: Hutchinson’s Sign and Beyond
episodes.description: Forehead vesicles, the nasociliary branch, and the ocular complications that demand slit lamp follow-up.

episodes.title: Corneal Dystrophies: Map-Dot-Fingerprint and Granular
episodes.description: The anterior and stromal dystrophies an optometrist will see — patterns, inheritance, and management.

episodes.title: Fuchs’ Endothelial Dystrophy: Guttae, Edema, and the Transplant Threshold
episodes.description: Morning blur, confluent guttae, and monitoring corneal thickness until DSAEK or DMEK becomes necessary.

episodes.title: Keratoconus: The Ectatic Cone and Early Detection
episodes.description: Topographic signs, fleischer ring, and the cross-linking referral that halts progression.

episodes.title: Corneal Cross-Linking: Halting the Ectatic Slide
episodes.description: The epi-off and epi-on protocols, what to expect during recovery, and post-CXL optometry care.

episodes.title: Pellucid Marginal Degeneration: The “Keratoconus Lookalike”
episodes.description: The inferior crab-claw topographic pattern and why standard contact lens fitting fails these patients.
